title: Prentis targets routine office work with specialised computer-use models
friendlyTitle: New AI lab Prentis wants agents to handle routine office tasks
summary: Prentis, a new lab focused on models that operate office software, is reportedly discussing a $100 million raise at a $1 billion valuation. It says its smaller Hive-32B model can automate document-heavy workflows at lower cost, but TechCrunch notes that its benchmark and revenue projections have not been independently verified.
friendlySummary: Prentis is building smaller AI models that use office software and automate document-heavy work. It is reportedly seeking $100 million, but its performance claims still need independent proof.
whyItMatters: Investment is moving from general chatbots toward agents built for repetitive work across documents and business systems. Buyers should demand task-level trials, security controls and realised savings rather than relying on vendor benchmark claims.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Office automation may become a major use of AI agents. Businesses should test real tasks and check security and savings before buying.
